items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: one of the guys in school whose name was Dwight Boone, had an old bass fiddle, so he brought this bass fiddle to school.

ctx.x: had to hear that sound. So down the road in a place called White Hill, one of the guys in school whose name was Dwight Boone, had an old bass fiddle, so he brought this bass fiddle to school. That was my introduction to the bass fiddle, which was very close to the tuba -- just a matter of months apart. So I always say I started both at the same time, although the tuba actually came first.
And you were how old when you started with the tuba?
